analysis.title: Specialist, BI Developer
analysis.fit_rationale: Strong alignment on core BI/ETL skills (SQL Server, Power BI, Python, ETL) and experience with data pipelines, reporting automation, and stakeholder collaboration. Gaps in formal SSIS/SSRS/SSAS production experience, finance systems, and non-profit sector exposure. Overall solid fit for a BI developer role with room to tailor.
strengths: Expert-level SQL and ETL design, with production experience on Oracle and SQL Server.
Advanced Python and Pandas, used for ETL, forecasting, and automation.
Current Power BI usage including migration support and Copilot integration.
Experience with data quality, testing, and pipeline monitoring.
Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions (capacity reporting, forecasting).
Strong communication and collaboration skills evidenced by cross-team work at Citi and consulting roles.
gaps: No explicit production experience with SSIS, SSRS, or SSAS (only foundational Azure data platform).
No direct experience with finance systems or non-profit sector.
Limited evidence of agile delivery or JIRA usage in a professional BI context (JIRA listed as source-supported but not detailed).
No formal BI-specific certifications or degree in computing (though not essential).
tailoring_plan: Update CV summary to position as BI/Data Engineer with strong SQL and Python. Add a 'BI & Reporting' section highlighting Power BI migration, automated capacity reports, and ETL pipelines. In cover letter, explicitly address SSIS/SSRS/SSAS by noting Azure Data Factory and Databricks as modern equivalents. Emphasize experience translating non-technical requirements into technical specs. Mention agile collaboration and JIRA usage from current role. If possible, obtain or highlight any Power BI certification.
